response:
Your current open accounts on your credit report include accounts with both positive and negative information. Positive information would include accounts that are current and in good standing, such as credit cards, auto loans, and student loans. Negative information would include accounts that are in default or have gone to collections, such as unpaid medical bills or unpaid fines. 

You can access your credit report from each of the three major credit bureaus free of charge once every 12 months through www.annualcreditreport.com. You can also request a copy of your credit report from each bureau by contacting them directly. See www.consumer.ftc.gov/articles/0152-free-credit-reports for more information on how to request your credit report.
